Event.title: PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds

bonuses: 2× Stardust for catching Pokémon.
An additional 3,000 XP from raids.
Pokémon encountered via GO Battle League rewards will have a wider variance of Attack, Defense, and HP.
Receive up to two additional free Raid Passes from spinning Gym Photo Discs.
The maximum number of sets you can play per day will increase from five to 15—for a total of 75 battles.

Event.description:
Celebrate PokémonXP and the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in Pokémon GO!
The PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds event will take place from August 25, 2026 at 10 am to August 30, 2026 at 8 pm local time.

2026 Pokémon World Championships: Friday, August 28, at 10:00 a.m. to Sunday, August 30, at 8:00 p.m. local time.

GO Battle League.title: Great League, Ultra League, and Master League | Forever Forward
GO Battle League.description:
The Great League, Ultra League, and Master League will run from August 25, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to September 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT.
Trainers will also receive 4× Stardust from win rewards (this does not include end-of-set rewards).
- Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
- Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter.
- All Pokémon are eligible.

GO Battle League.title: Great League, Ultra League, and Master League: Mega Edition | Forever Forward
GO Battle League.description:
The Great League, Ultra League, and Master League: Mega Edition will run from September 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to September 8, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT.
Trainers will also receive 4× Stardust from win rewards (this does not include end-of-set rewards).
- Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
- Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter.
- No CP limit.
- Mega-Evolved Pokémon are allowed.

Pokémon GO Fest.title: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale

bonuses: All Mega-Evolved Pokémon will receive an extra CP boost from Saturday, September 5, to Sunday, September 6, 2026
Bonus Candy, Candy XL, and XP from Mega Raids
Increased chance of encountering Shiny Pokémon from certain Mega Raids and event Pokémon encounters
No limit on Remote Raids from Saturday, September 5, to Sunday, September 6, 2026

Pokémon GO Fest.description:
Rally with Trainers around the world for the mega conclusion of Pokémon GO Fest 2026! Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale brings Armored Mewtwo in five-star raids, rotating habitats, powerful Mega Raids, and Super Mega Raids featuring Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y.
Prepare during the lead-up event Mega Ascension, then join this unticketed worldwide weekend finale.
The Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale event will take place from September 5, 2026 at 10 am to September 6, 2026 at 6 pm local time.

Season.title: Forever Forward

bonuses: 2× Daily Adventure Incense duration
Increased XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs
Increased limits on opening, receiving from PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs, and storing Gifts
One additional Candy for trading Pokémon

Season.description:
Welcome to Pokémon GO: Forever Forward!
In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.
